craft_notes: Sthāyin: utkrānti unit 50. Sanskrit-first kept. Rows: 2. Close: rest. Rejected: smoothing — killed: flagged. Read aloud: steady cadence.

lines: Of one engaged, by nature, in that released: not indeed loss. But the
sādhaka always in the to-be-accomplished fruit, from rule-constraint.
l4.sanskrit_cite: pravṛttasya svabhāvena tasminmukte na vai kṣatiḥ sādhakastu sadā sādhye phale niyatiyantraṇāt
